# Month-end close in SAP Business One: the Friday checklist

Before the month-end close, reconcile the bank account against the statement,
clear the GR/IR suspense account, and post any missing goods receipts while
the warehouse team is still around to answer questions. Our controller runs
the aging report on the last Friday and flags every open item older than
30 days by name, not by total, so nothing hides inside a round number.

Three habits made our close boring, which is the goal. First, cycle counting
during the month instead of one annual shutdown count. Second, approvals
inside the system instead of by email, so the audit trail exists. Third, a
one-page checklist taped to the monitor: bank, suspense, aging, in that
order, every month, no improvisation.
